test.title: 4.2.1 (review of check_facts by Fable 5.2, 10.11: seven defects, each reproduced on the old code before the fix)
test.checks: a sentence-initial word is a name only when the same name stands elsewhere in another case («То» is not «Томске», «Там» is not «Тамара», «Сбер» is «Сбера»); a footnote mark («болота.[1] Там») and a chat citation after the period do not hide the sentence start, and a citation without a period does not make one («сотрудничаем[cite: 1] Microsoft» keeps the name); a number glued to its unit («500мл», «990р.», «2019г.», «30к», «160х200») is the same number and unit as the spaced form, «B2B», «3D», «1С» and «Pro2» stay silent; a mention lost together with its own unit («скидка 5%») is a lost fact, not a rarer one; a hedge turned the other way («не менее 5» → «не более 5», «после 20 мая» → «до 20 мая») is an error, the same hedge in other words («минимум», «не позже») is not, and dates are compared by their hedge too; «Вместо того чтобы купить» is a check, «Не покупайте» → «Покупайте» is an error; a run of 16 digits is compared as it is written and a 320-digit run does not crash; a text of 97 000 characters is checked in under 10 s (the occurrences of a word are counted once); the values of the chat assistant's own lines («Готово, вот текст:», «Если нужно, могу…») are reported apart as «service», not as errors, and the receipt line names them. Review of the code (Claude Opus 5.5, 10.11) added two cases that failed on the first version: a footnote mark of two or three digits («[12]», «(127)») and a value the source bounds both ways («до 30 ноября» … «После 30 ноября» → «после этого»: a dropped hedge, not a flip; found by check_scripts --against main in final3 prompt m03). The Stop-hook cross-review (Sol and MiniMax, 10.11, two rounds, ten findings, each reproduced by a test that failed before the fix) added: author lines that look like a wrapper stay facts («Вариант 1 — доставка в Казань.», «Готовим к запуску 3 магазина.», «Вот наши новости: …», «Вот письмо от Microsoft.», «**Вариант 1 (доставка в Казань)**», «Если хотите, могу доставить заказ в Казань.»), so a head needs «готово», a size or a colon at its end, a tail needs words about the text, and option headings are never service; «50м²» is «50 м²»; «30к рублей» is «30 тыс. рублей»; grouped long digit runs are compared exactly; a long run keeps its scale («тыс.»); «Павлу» is a case of «Павел» (fleeting vowel), so a swap of his sum is seen; «не менее» and «не **менее**» are the same hedge. Evidence: check_scripts.py --against main over 2410 eval edits, every changed row read by eye (V-M-CHECK-SCRIPTS); parity 3656 pairs, 0 differences; the sverka page in the built-in browser shows the service values in their own block, outside the fix request

check_facts.py compares quotes up to a paragraph (500 characters) in «», „“, “” and up to 80 in straight marks; single quotes, longer quotes and quotes across a line break are not compared. It cannot tell a quotation from a term or an example inside a phrase, so only direct speech, quotes after a colon and a dash-opened dialogue line are errors; a lost quotation inside a phrase is only a check.

check_facts.py cannot tell a name from another name with the same stem (Мария/Марина, Марии/Марине) or a fleeting vowel beyond stem matching (Лев/Льва); a number rewritten as a word for a unit («24 часа» → «сутки») is reported as lost on purpose (numbers are carried as is); prose wrapped in ``` and a code block of mostly Cyrillic text are not compared as code. A month is found only as a noun in lower case or at a sentence start (adjectives «майские», «январский» are not months); a three-part dotted number with a two-digit month and year (3.11.12) is read as a date unless «версия», «релиз», «сборка» or v stands before it. Amounts where an inserted appositive between commas splits an item («Анна, врач, получила 30 000») are not bound (unambiguous «и»-joined person+amount pairs and item/product/tariff enumerations like «капучино 250 ₽, латте 300 ₽» are bound since 4.3.0). A difference in a comparison («на 20 000 меньше Бориса») is bound to the name in the comparison, so a rewrite that moves it into another person's part («Анна заработала 30 000 — на 20 000 меньше, чем Борис») gives a false swap error that 4.1.5 did not give (found by a reviewer; none on the 1446 old edits). A name the script does not recognise (a rare name or surname right after «руб.,», where the dot reads as a sentence end) can bind a number to its neighbour: 1 false alarm in 3000 generated rewrites with «руб.» (reordering «…Захар 450 руб. и Жанна 2 400 руб.»). A hedge word without a synonym (после, до, от) that stays at one mention of a number covers its loss at another; a hedge is not seen when a word other than «чем» stands between it and the number («минимум за 6»), and a synonym the script does not know («короче 3 дней» for «меньше 3 дней») counts as a lost hedge (source bold/italic marks around hedges and «не свыше» are handled since 4.3.0). Two people who share a first name or a surname are told apart by the other word; named in one sentence only by the shared word they are nobody's (silent), and a person who shares one word with two others (Анна Иванова, Анна Петрова, Борис Петров: Анна Петрова has no word of her own) cannot be bound.
check_facts.py does not see lost conditions in words ("при включённой двухфакторной аутентификации"); the skill tells the agent to reread conditions.

The comparison emulates a skill run through the API with a read_file tool; installed runs in Claude Code and DSH are checked by hand on a few texts. final4 ran the executor as Claude Code subagents in batches (README), so its numbers compare participants with each other, not with earlier runs.
